title: Initial controlled-substance inventory
rule_summary: A newly registered handler must take an inventory of controlled substances on hand on the date first engaging in controlled-substance activity.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply initial inventory requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing initial inventory with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
